name: My Wish To You
source:
A villager visits a shrine, once abandoned by a goddess and now inhabited by you, and begs for the Spring Festival to be held once again. Usually, the Spring Festival is held at the end of the season, when spring turns to summer. The problem is, there's only six weeks until then! Will you be able to get this shrine festival-ready by season's end?

Decide how you'll spend your time (and who you'll spend it with) in this stat-raising otome!

[From [url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/my-wish-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
